#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independent integral24 native comparison candidate, SOURCE_ONLY_NOT_RUN.

Expected observations come exclusively from the fixed original actual Torch24 JSON.
Every original case and event remains present. Missing native observations
are BLOCKED and numeric/identity discrepancies are FAIL, never substituted.
The actual corrected source, ELF and emission must be separately bound.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import struct
import sys
import traceback

from admit_reference24 import (admit_reference, file_bytes, product, require,
                               sha, REFERENCE_SHA, CONTRACT_SHA)
from admit_integral_build import admit_build

PARENT_CASE = "52c3b3242a73fb412102c83c5ba47cf8d95a4eb3c01e56f41bfe593066506d05"
PARENT_OBSERVER = "59019b5c4aeae0d7e04b362354bd9ca55917d2196791d3d18c4908a05fdbba8b"
PARENT_OWNER = "e54509ceba0ef3bf171f5fc1018665dc97e56eeccec0cba1e8c14f9a7ed81501"
PROTOCOL = "7a30d7bca140e3a4cc9d63a3e6930b92d2ffd60ad4503895419d8a63e67c8bd9"
CLIENT = "dee3e4cb25ee1e5e06513e2f33478fbe274d9510ce2aaab9525815c72312946b"
SOURCE_REVISION = "sum-source03"
ORIGINAL_SOURCE02_PACKAGE = "670ae1fbcb487a54d13a50570bb10bd86b0a19cb0e74dbcb7eec66122d4b9564"
ORIGINAL_PACKAGE = "9b3ff11fb8a4e2d08020049b892cc42f4717ac68c744cffce88d68f55cd07660"
U64_MAX = (1 << 64)-1

def write_json(path, value):
    with Path(path).open("x", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
        stream.write("\n")

def load_module(path, name):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, Path(path))
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module

def admit_package(root, expected_sha, inputs):
    raw, _ = file_bytes(root/"source-manifest.json", expected_sha, inputs)
    manifest = json.loads(raw)
    require(manifest["schema"] == "heptatorch.sum-dims-native32.source-only.v3"
            and manifest["status"] == "SOURCE_ONLY_NOT_RUN"
            and manifest["source_revision"] == SOURCE_REVISION
            and manifest["source_sha256"] == "be841bf3468b4ce6ce66daead602d540839dadb1f8ceca2fd3b5940ff2e6d545" and manifest["actual_child_binding"] == "PENDING",
            "native32-package-profile")
    files = manifest["files"]
    required = {"replay_sum32.py", "admit_reference32.py", "admit_build.py",
                "native_observer_sum02.py", "owner_sum47_48.py", "observer-inverse.json",
                "profile.json", "coverage-contract.json", "README.md",
                "actual-build-binding.json", "execution-request-placeholder.json",
                "vendor/replay_direct_view14.py", "vendor/native_observer_shape02.py",
                "vendor/owner_view05.py", "vendor/protocol.py", "vendor/owner_client.py",
                "revision01-source-manifest.json", "revision01-inverse.json",
                "revision02-source-manifest.json", "revision02-inverse.json",
                "publication-core-inverse.json", "case30-publication-proof.json",
                "publication-copied-controls.py"}
    require(set(files) == required and manifest["file_count"] == len(required),
            "exact-native32-payload-set")
    total = 0
    for relative, pin in files.items():
        parts = PurePosixPath(relative)
        require(not parts.is_absolute() and ".." not in parts.parts and parts.as_posix() == relative,
                "safe-native32-member")
        value, record = file_bytes(root/relative, pin["sha256"], inputs)
        require({k: record[k] for k in ("sha256", "bytes", "mode")} == pin,
                "native32-original-member-byte-mode", member=relative)
        total += len(value)
    require(total == manifest["payload_bytes"], "native32-full-payload-byte-count")
    # Validate source03 -> source02 for every original payload before applying
    # the unchanged original source02 -> source01 and parent-owner inverses.
    # This in-memory ancestry view is never executed or used as a current input;
    # the caller's inputs still contain only the actual source03 bytes/modes.
    parent2_raw = inputs[str((root/"revision02-source-manifest.json").resolve())]["raw"]
    require(sha(parent2_raw) == ORIGINAL_SOURCE02_PACKAGE, "frozen-complete-source02-manifest")
    parent2 = json.loads(parent2_raw)
    proof2 = json.loads(inputs[str((root/"revision02-inverse.json").resolve())]["raw"])
    require(set(proof2["files"]) == set(parent2["files"]) and len(parent2["files"]) == 18,
            "all-eighteen-source02-payloads-have-whole-byte-inverse")
    ancestral_inputs = {}
    for name, pin in parent2["files"].items():
        entry = proof2["files"][name]
        current = inputs[str((root/name).resolve())]["raw"]
        require(entry["before_sha256"] == pin["sha256"] and
                entry["after_sha256"] == sha(current), "source03-inverse-current-and-parent-pin", path=name)
        restored = current
        for change in reversed(entry["edits"]):
            before, after = change["before"].encode(), change["after"].encode()
            require(before and after and type(change["count"]) is int and change["count"] > 0
                    and restored.count(after) == change["count"], "source03-inverse-exact-occurrence", path=name)
            restored = restored.replace(after, before)
        require(len(restored) == pin["bytes"] and sha(restored) == pin["sha256"],
                "source03-whole-byte-inverse-exact-source02", path=name)
        forward = restored
        for change in entry["edits"]:
            before, after = change["before"].encode(), change["after"].encode()
            require(forward.count(before) == change["count"], "source03-forward-exact-occurrence", path=name)
            forward = forward.replace(before, after)
        require(forward == current, "source03-whole-byte-forward-exact", path=name)
        ancestral_inputs[str((root/name).resolve())] = {
            "raw":restored, "record":{"path":str((root/name).resolve()), **pin}}
    require(proof2["original_source02_manifest_sha256"] == ORIGINAL_SOURCE02_PACKAGE,
            "source03-complete-parent-custody-bound")
    inputs, files = ancestral_inputs, parent2["files"]
    for name, digest in (("replay_direct_view14.py", PARENT_CASE),
                         ("native_observer_shape02.py", PARENT_OBSERVER),
                         ("owner_view05.py", PARENT_OWNER),
                         ("protocol.py", PROTOCOL), ("owner_client.py", CLIENT)):
        require(files["vendor/"+name]["sha256"] == digest, "immutable-parent-helper", name=name)
    inverse = json.loads(inputs[str((root/"observer-inverse.json").resolve())]["raw"])
    for entry in inverse["whole_file_inverses"]:
        old = inputs[str((root/entry["original"]).resolve())]["raw"]
        new = inputs[str((root/entry["adapted"]).resolve())]["raw"]
        suffix = entry["additive_suffix"].encode()
        require(new.endswith(suffix), "explicit-additive-suffix", path=entry["adapted"])
        reconstructed = new[:-len(suffix)]
        for change in reversed(entry["replacements"]):
            before, after = change["before"].encode(), change["after"].encode()
            require(reconstructed.count(after) == change["occurrences"],
                    "inverse-replacement-occurrence", path=entry["adapted"])
            reconstructed = reconstructed.replace(after, before)
        require(reconstructed == old and sha(old) == entry["original_sha256"],
                "whole-original-byte-inverse", path=entry["adapted"])
    require(len(inverse["whole_file_inverses"]) == 2 and
            inverse["original_case_file_imported_unmodified"] == PARENT_CASE,
            "complete-two-observer-inverses")
    original_raw = inputs[str((root/"revision01-source-manifest.json").resolve())]["raw"]
    require(sha(original_raw) == ORIGINAL_PACKAGE, "frozen-source01-manifest")
    original = json.loads(original_raw)
    revision = json.loads(inputs[str((root/"revision01-inverse.json").resolve())]["raw"])
    require(set(revision["files"]) == set(original["files"])
            and len(revision["files"]) == 16, "whole-source01-revision-coverage")
    for old_name, proof in revision["files"].items():
        new_name = proof["new_path"]
        require(new_name in files, "revision02-real-file", path=new_name)
        actual = inputs[str((root/new_name).resolve())]["raw"]
        require(sha(actual) == proof["new_sha256"], "revision02-inverse-new-pin", path=new_name)
        restored = actual
        for edit in reversed(proof["edits"]):
            before, after = edit["before"].encode(), edit["after"].encode()
            require(restored.count(after) == edit["occurrences"],
                    "revision02-inverse-exact-occurrence", path=new_name)
            restored = restored.replace(after, before)
        require(sha(restored) == original["files"][old_name]["sha256"] == proof["old_sha256"]
                and len(restored) == original["files"][old_name]["bytes"],
                "revision02-whole-source01-byte-inverse", path=new_name)
    return manifest

def admit_integral_package(root, expected_sha, parent_root, inputs):
    parent_manifest = admit_package(parent_root, "f13a204f5071c07b34ab35ee1b4a6dc90163137b0762fb57bd8c34abb0c8b277", inputs)
    raw, _ = file_bytes(root/"source-manifest.json", expected_sha, inputs)
    manifest = json.loads(raw)
    require(manifest["schema"] == "heptatorch.sum-integral.native24-source.v1" and
            manifest["status"] == "SOURCE_ONLY_NOT_RUN" and
            manifest["expected_functions"] == 699 and manifest["actual_emission_units"] == 14 and
            manifest["actual_emission_source_sha256"] == "afd54444849ed10f7b4af53231c9db6542854b70f33e3927f8b05dfbb23ed1e3" and
            manifest["case_count"] == 24 and manifest["case_contract_sha256"] == CONTRACT_SHA and
            manifest["actual_child_binding"] == "PENDING",
            "integral-native24-source-only-package")
    files = manifest["files"]
    require(len(files) == manifest["file_count"] and all(isinstance(x,str) for x in files),
            "native24-manifest-member-set")
    found = {str(p.relative_to(root)) for p in root.rglob("*") if p.is_file()}
    require(found == set(files) | {"source-manifest.json"} and
            not any(p.is_symlink() for p in root.rglob("*")), "exact-native24-directory-members")
    total = 0
    for name, pin in files.items():
        rel = PurePosixPath(name)
        require(not rel.is_absolute() and ".." not in rel.parts and str(rel) == name,
                "native24-safe-member")
        value, record = file_bytes(root/name, pin["sha256"], inputs)
        require({k:record[k] for k in ("bytes","sha256","mode")} == pin,
                "native24-member-bytes-and-original-mode", path=name)
        total += len(value)
    require(total == manifest["payload_bytes"], "native24-complete-payload-size")
    proof = json.loads(inputs[str((root/"source-inverses.json").resolve())]["raw"])
    require(proof["parent_manifest_sha256"] == "f13a204f5071c07b34ab35ee1b4a6dc90163137b0762fb57bd8c34abb0c8b277",
            "whole-source-parent-manifest")
    expected = {
        "replay_integral24.py":"replay_sum32.py",
        "admit_reference24.py":"admit_reference32.py",
        "admit_integral_build.py":"admit_build.py",
        "native_observer_integral.py":"native_observer_sum02.py",
        "owner_integral.py":"owner_sum47_48.py"}
    require(set(proof["files"]) == set(expected), "all-five-derived-whole-source-inverses")
    for current_name, parent_name in expected.items():
        entry = proof["files"][current_name]
        old = inputs[str((parent_root/parent_name).resolve())]["raw"]
        new = inputs[str((root/current_name).resolve())]["raw"]
        require(sha(old) == entry["before_sha256"] and sha(new) == entry["after_sha256"],
                "whole-inverse-exact-old-and-new-pins", path=current_name)
        restored = new
        for edit in reversed(entry["edits"]):
            before, after = edit["before"].encode(), edit["after"].encode()
            require(before and after and type(edit["count"]) is int and edit["count"] > 0 and
                    restored.count(after) == edit["count"], "inverse-exact-count", path=current_name)
            restored = restored.replace(after,before)
        require(restored == old, "whole-inverse-exact-original-file", path=current_name)
        forward = old
        for edit in entry["edits"]:
            before, after = edit["before"].encode(), edit["after"].encode()
            require(forward.count(before) == edit["count"], "forward-exact-count", path=current_name)
            forward = forward.replace(before,after)
        require(forward == new, "whole-forward-exact-current-file", path=current_name)
    return manifest

def normalized_status(event):
    if event["accepted"]:
        return 0
    error = event["error"]
    kind, message = error["type"], error["message"]
    if event["label"] == "result_requires_grad_true" and kind == "RuntimeError" and (
            "only tensors of floating point" in message.lower() and "require gradients" in message.lower()):
        return 5
    if event["label"] == "backward_integer_result" and kind == "RuntimeError" and (
            "does not require grad" in message and "does not have a grad_fn" in message):
        return 5
    if kind == "RuntimeError" and re.fullmatch(r"dim [0-9]+ appears multiple times in the list of dims", message):
        return 7
    if kind == "IndexError" and message.startswith("Dimension out of range (expected to be in range of ["):
        return 2
    if kind == "RuntimeError" and message.startswith("Mismatch in shape: grad_output[0] has a shape of "):
        return 2
    if kind == "RuntimeError" and ("backward through the graph a second time" in message
                                    or "saved tensors have already been freed" in message):
        return 10
    if kind == "RuntimeError" and "modified by an inplace operation" in message and "version" in message:
        return 6
    raise UnsupportedObservation("unmapped-actual-exception", {"error": error})

class UnsupportedObservation(Exception):
    def __init__(self, reason, facts=None):
        self.reason, self.facts = reason, facts or {}
        super().__init__(reason)

def case_class(parent, owner):
    class IntegralCase(parent.Case):
        # The original class remains byte-identical in vendor. These methods
        # add new roles and inputs; inherited check/issue/compare_node/gradient/
        # snapshot/expired logic retains the original predicates.
        def __init__(self, args, observer, reference, row, spec, directory):
            self.spec, self.blockers, self.completed_events = spec, [], []
            self.active_event = None
            self.unmapped_observations = []
            self.seed_geometry_sources = []
            self.tensor_weak_targets = {}
            try:
                super().__init__(args, observer, reference, row, directory)
            except BaseException:
                if hasattr(self, "n"):
                    try:
                        self.n.finish()
                    except BaseException as cleanup_error:
                        write_json(directory/"constructor-cleanup-error.json",
                                   {"error": repr(cleanup_error)})
                raise

        def blocked(self, reason, **facts):
            item = {"path": self.current_path, "reason": reason, **facts}
            self.blockers.append(item)
            return item

        def tensor(self, expected, actual, label):
            super().tensor(expected, actual, label)
            if expected is not None and actual is not None:
                old = self.current_path
                self.current_path += "/"+label
                for name in ("device", "storage_offset_bytes", "storage_sha256", "logical_sha256"):
                    self.check(name, actual[name], expected[name])
                self.current_path = old

        def node_info(self, index, depth=4):
            if not index:
                return None
            memory = self.mem()
            node = memory.node(index)
            op = node[5]
            if op == 0:
                raw = self.n.s.owner()
                snapshot = owner.decode_owner(raw["bytes"], raw["pointer"])
                owner.verify_snapshot(snapshot)
                target = owner.accumulator_target(snapshot, index)
                actual = memory.tensor(target)
                self.check("Accumulator-real-target-incarnation",
                           actual["native_incarnation"],
                           snapshot["nodes"][str(target)][40], True)
                result = {"kind": "AccumulateGrad", "variable": actual}
                if depth:
                    result["next_edges"] = []
                return result
            kinds = {3: "MulBackward0", 17: "CloneBackward0",
                     43: "ToCopyBackward0", 44: "AsStridedBackward0",
                     47: "SumBackward1", 48: "PermuteBackward0"}
            if op not in kinds:
                raise UnsupportedObservation("native-history-kind-outside-revision02-mapping",
                                             {"node": index, "opcode": op})
            result = {"kind": kinds[op]}
            if depth:
                count = 2 if op == 3 else 1
                result["next_edges"] = [
                    {"output_nr": 0,
                     "node": self.node_info(node[6+i], depth-1) if node[9+i] else None}
                    for i in range(count)]
            return result

        def add_weak(self, name, token):
            # Execute Python's RHS StorageWeakRef creation before replacing the
            # existing name. Release the former Weak after the actual new42.
            fresh = self.n.one(42, token)["value"]
            previous = self.weak.get(name)
            if previous is not None:
                self.n.one(44, previous)
            self.weak[name] = fresh

        def saved_attributes(self, token, expected):
            memory = self.mem()
            index = memory.public_node(token)
            node = memory.node(index)
            if node[5] not in (47, 48):
                if node[5] not in (0, 3, 17, 43, 44):
                    raise UnsupportedObservation("unmapped-original-Saved-getter-role",
                                                 {"node": index, "opcode": node[5]})
                return super().saved_attributes(token, expected)
            raw = self.n.s.owner()
            snapshot = owner.decode_owner(raw["bytes"], raw["pointer"])
            owner.verify_snapshot(snapshot)
            if node[5] == 47:
                metadata = owner.sum_metadata(snapshot, index)
                values = {"_saved_dim": metadata["original_u64_axes"],
                          "_saved_keepdim": metadata["keepdim"],
                          "_saved_self_sym_sizes": metadata["sizes"]}
            else:
                metadata = owner.permute_metadata(snapshot, index)
                values = {"_saved_dims": metadata["original_u64_axes"]}
            self.check("shape-Saved-exact-attribute-set", list(expected), list(values))
            observed = {}
            for name, value in values.items():
                if name not in expected:
                    continue
                event = expected[name]
                self.check(name+"/accepted", event["accepted"], True)
                self.check(name+"/outcome", event["outcome"], "SUCCEEDED")
                self.check(name+"/error", event["error"], None)
                self.check(name+"/warnings", event["warnings"], [])
                self.check(name+"/exact-value", value, event.get("value"))
                observed[name] = {"accepted": True, "outcome": "SUCCEEDED",
                                  "error": None, "warnings": [], "value": value,
                                  "native_node_words_176_184": metadata["raw_words_176_184"]}
            return observed

        def snapshot(self, expected, label):
            before_count = len(self.snapshots)
            super().snapshot(expected, label)
            self.check("exact-one-snapshot-appended", len(self.snapshots), before_count+1, True)
            self.snapshots[-1]["unmapped_observation_blockers_so_far"] = len(self.blockers)
            self.snapshots[-1]["tensor_weak_alive"] = self.check_tensor_weak(expected["tensor_weak_alive"])
            # Base snapshot already compares raw geometry, complete words,
            # identities, graph edges, getter statuses, retains, G, weak and
            # full5056 RNG. Compare the otherwise silent capture error/warning
            # fields explicitly instead of inferring them from summary counts.
            for name in expected["tensor_getter_order"]:
                wanted = expected["tensors"][name]
                for field in ("grad_fn_getter", "is_leaf_after_grad_fn_getter", "retains_grad", "gradient"):
                    capture = wanted[field]
                    self.check(name+"/"+field+"/successful-error-none", capture["error"], None)
                    self.check(name+"/"+field+"/successful-outcome", capture["outcome"], "SUCCEEDED")
                    if field != "gradient":
                        self.check(name+"/"+field+"/no-warning", capture["warnings"], [])
                self.check(name+"/edge-getter-error", expected["edge_getters"][name]["error"], None)
            # Python's warning message is a retained frontend diagnostic; the
            # native wire has no text stream for warnings. Its actual condition
            # and count/type are compared by the original gradient method.

        def published(self, name, token):
            super().published(name, token)
            memory = self.mem()
            index = memory.public_node(token)
            node = memory.node(index)
            self.check("weak-Tensor-published-real-role", bool(node[30]) and bool(node[38]), True, True)
            self.tensor_weak_targets[name+"_tensor"] = {
                "node": index, "incarnation": node[40],
                "initial_public_token": token}
            # No native retain or extra Tensor is created for a weak target.

        def check_tensor_weak(self, expected):
            self.check("Tensor-weak-name-order", list(self.tensor_weak_targets), list(expected), True)
            memory, actual = self.mem(), {}
            for name, target in self.tensor_weak_targets.items():
                index, incarnation = target["node"], target["incarnation"]
                alive = False
                if 0 < index < memory.q(8):
                    node = memory.node(index)
                    alive = bool(node[38] and node[30] and node[40] == incarnation)
                    if alive:
                        row = memory.row(1, node[24])
                        self.check("Tensor-weak-real-current-Trow/"+name,
                                   (row[6], list(row[2:5])), (index, [node[27], node[28], node[29]]), True)
                actual[name] = alive
                self.check("Tensor-weak-liveness/"+name, alive, expected[name])
            return actual

        def issue_one(self, command, label, partial=False):
            return self.issue(command, label, partial=partial)

        def make_integral_tensor(self, dtype, shape, words):
            self.check("typed-input-dtype", dtype in (1, 2), True, True)
            self.check("typed-input-shape-rank", len(shape) <= 4, True, True)
            self.check("typed-input-word-count", len(words), product(shape), True)
            width = 1 if dtype == 1 else 8
            self.check("typed-input-literal-hex-width", all(
                isinstance(x, str) and len(x) == 2*width and
                all(c in "0123456789abcdef" for c in x) for x in words), True, True)
            raw = (bytes(int(x,16) for x in words) if dtype == 1 else
                   b"".join(struct.pack("<Q", int(x,16)) for x in words))
            return self.n.create(dtype, list(shape), raw, requires=0)

        def event_plan(self, event):
            label, spec = event["label"], self.spec
            literal, target = spec["input"], spec["target"]
            commands, token, publish, record, status = [], None, None, None, 0
            if label == "construct_backing":
                dtype = 1 if literal["dtype"] == "Bool" else 2
                words = literal["base_storage_words"]
                token = self.make_integral_tensor(dtype, [len(words)], words)
                publish = "backing"
                commands = [{"semantic": "typed97-literal-integral-backing",
                             "dtype": dtype, "shape": [len(words)], "hex_words": words}]
            elif label == "construct_strided_input":
                command = self.view(self.live["backing"], literal["shape"],
                                    literal["strides"], literal["storage_offset"])
                status, record = self.issue_one(command, label)
                token, publish, commands = record["value"] if status == 0 else None, "input", [command]
            elif label == "sum_dim_IntList":
                axes = target["dimension_argument"]
                count = U64_MAX if axes is None else len(axes)
                payload = 0 if not axes else self.n.w.Payload(struct.pack("<"+"q"*len(axes), *axes))
                dtype = U64_MAX if target["dtype"] == "None" else 2
                command = (115, self.live["input"], count, payload,
                           int(target["keepdim"]), dtype, 0, 0)
                status, record = self.issue_one(command, label)
                token, publish, commands = record["value"] if status == 0 else None, "result", [command]
            elif label == "result_requires_grad_true":
                command = (90, self.live["result"], 1)
                before = self.owner(label+"/before")
                status, record = self.issue_one(command, label)
                after = self.owner(label+"/after")
                if status:
                    self.check(label+"/whole-no-grad-refusal-owner",
                               (after["pointer"], after["length"], after["bytes"]),
                               (before["pointer"], before["length"], before["bytes"]))
                    self.rollback_bytes += len(before["bytes"])
                token, commands = self.live["result"] if status == 0 else None, [command]
            elif label == "construct_explicit_integer_seed":
                # Only the actual pre-event result geometry supplies a seed
                # allocation. All values are the declared literal one; no
                # reference result/gradient values feed native Tensor math.
                source = event["before"]["tensors"]["result"]["before_grad_fn_getter"]
                self.check("explicit-seed-result-dtype", source["dtype"], "torch.int64", True)
                shape, count = source["shape"], source["numel"]
                self.check("explicit-seed-source-numel", product(shape), count, True)
                token = self.make_integral_tensor(2, shape, ["0000000000000001"]*count)
                publish = "seed"
                commands = [{"semantic": "typed97-explicit-ones-input", "dtype": 2,
                             "shape": shape, "literal_u64": "0000000000000001"}]
                self.seed_geometry_sources.append({"event": self.active_event,
                    "source": "original_actual_before.result.shape_only",
                    "shape": shape, "numel": count,
                    "no_reference_numeric_result_used_as_input": True})
            elif label == "backward_integer_result":
                command = (58, self.live["result"], self.live["seed"], 0)
                before = self.owner(label+"/before")
                status, record = self.issue_one(command, label, partial=True)
                after = self.owner(label+"/after")
                if status:
                    self.check(label+"/whole-no-grad-refusal-owner",
                               (after["pointer"], after["length"], after["bytes"]),
                               (before["pointer"], before["length"], before["bytes"]))
                    self.rollback_bytes += len(before["bytes"])
                commands = [command]
            elif label == "hold_result":
                token, publish = self.live["result"], "held_result"
                commands = [{"semantic": "same-Python-object-local-name",
                             "source_name": "result", "additional_native_retain": False}]
            elif label.startswith("drop_") or label.startswith("final_drop_"):
                name = label[len("final_drop_"):] if label.startswith("final_drop_") else label[len("drop_"):]
                self.check("drop-existing-explicit-name", name in self.live, True, True)
                dropped = self.live[name]
                if sum(x == dropped for x in self.live.values()) == 1:
                    command = (41, dropped)
                    status, record = self.issue_one(command, label)
                    commands = [command]
                if status == 0:
                    del self.live[name]
            else:
                raise UnsupportedObservation("unmapped-integral24-event", {"label": label})
            return status, record, token, publish, commands

        def execute(self, event, event_index):
            self.active_event = event_index
            label = event["label"]
            self.snapshot(event["before"], "event%03d/%s/before" % (event_index, label))
            self.current_path = "event%03d/%s/operation" % (event_index, label)
            wanted = normalized_status(event)
            status, record, token, publish, commands = self.event_plan(event)
            self.check("normalized-operation-status", status, wanted)
            operation = {"label": label, "reference_event": event_index,
                         "normalized_actual_status": status, "normalized_reference_status": wanted,
                         "reference_error": event["error"], "reference_warnings": event["warnings"],
                         "native_diagnostic_text_available": False,
                         "commands": parent.safe(commands), "record": parent.safe(record)}
            self.check("operation-warning-list", event["warnings"], [])
            if (wanted == 0) != (status == 0):
                self.operations.append(operation)
                raise parent.RequiredOperationFailed(("native/reference acceptance mismatch", label, status, wanted))
            if status == 0:
                returned = event["returned"]
                if isinstance(returned, dict) and "tensor" in returned:
                    self.check("returned-Tensor-present", bool(token), True, True)
                    actual = self.raw_tensor(token)
                    self.tensor(returned["tensor"], actual, "returned_Tensor")
                    self.check("returned-is-existing",
                               {name: value == token for name, value in self.live.items()},
                               event["returned_is_existing"])
                    operation["returned_tensor"] = actual
                else:
                    self.check("returned-primitive", returned, None)
                if publish is not None:
                    self.check("published-name-currently-absent", publish not in self.live, True, True)
                    self.published(publish, token)
            self.operations.append(operation)
            self.snapshot(event["after"], "event%03d/%s/after" % (event_index, label))
            self.completed_events.append(event_index)

        def run(self):
            error = None
            terminal_block = None
            try:
                for i, event in enumerate(self.row["events"]):
                    if event["label"].startswith("final_drop_") and not getattr(self, "final_snap_done", False):
                        self.snapshot(self.row["before_final_drops"], "before_final_drops")
                        self.final_snap_done = True
                    self.execute(event, i)
                if not getattr(self, "final_snap_done", False):
                    self.snapshot(self.row["before_final_drops"], "before_final_drops")
                self.current_path = "final"
                self.check("all-public-names-dropped", self.live, {})
                self.check_expired(self.row["final_expired"])
                self.check_tensor_weak(self.row["final_tensor_weak_alive"])
                rng = self.n.one(63, self.gen)["payload"]
                expected_rng = bytes.fromhex(self.reference["states"][self.row["state_after"]]["hex"])
                self.check("final-complete5056MT", rng, expected_rng)
                self.rng_bytes += len(expected_rng)
                self.check("final-native-audit", self.n.one(53)["value"], 1)
                self.owner("final_before_observer_release")
                for token in self.weak.values():
                    self.n.one(44, token)
                self.n.one(66, self.gen)
            except UnsupportedObservation as unsupported:
                terminal_block = self.blocked(unsupported.reason, **unsupported.facts)
                try:
                    self.owner("unsupported_observation_original_owner")
                except BaseException as nested:
                    error = {"type": type(nested).__name__, "message": str(nested),
                             "at": self.current_path, "traceback": traceback.format_exc()}
            except BaseException as failure:
                error = {"type": type(failure).__name__, "message": str(failure),
                         "traceback": traceback.format_exc(), "at": self.current_path}
                try:
                    self.owner("first_failure")
                except BaseException as nested:
                    error["owner_capture_error"] = repr(nested)
            finally:
                try:
                    self.n.finish()
                except BaseException as failure:
                    if error is None:
                        error = {"type": "EOF_FAILURE", "message": repr(failure), "at": self.current_path}
                    else:
                        error["EOF_failure"] = repr(failure)
            missing = [i for i in range(len(self.row["events"])) if i not in self.completed_events]
            status = ("FAIL" if error is not None or self.failures else
                      "BLOCKED" if self.blockers or missing else "PASS")
            report = {"index": self.row["index"], "name": self.row["name"], "status": status,
                "assertions": self.checks, "exact_words": self.words,
                "full_rng_bytes": self.rng_bytes, "rollback_bytes": self.rollback_bytes,
                "frames": self.n.s.frames, "exit_code": self.n.s.exit_code,
                "error": error, "mismatches": self.failures, "blockers": self.blockers,
                "terminal_blocker": terminal_block, "operations": self.operations,
                "snapshots": self.snapshots, "owner_records": self.owner_records,
                "owner_blobs": self.owner_blobs,
                "complete_frame_owner_blobs": self.n.owner_blobs,
                "complete_frame_count": len(self.n.boundaries),
                "full_transition_recomputed": False,
                "reference_event_count": len(self.row["events"]),
                "completed_reference_events": self.completed_events,
                "unattempted_reference_events": [
                    {"index": i, "label": self.row["events"][i]["label"]} for i in missing],
                "seed_geometry_sources": self.seed_geometry_sources,
                "schema_closure": False, "full_project_status": "HOLD"}
            write_json(self.directory/"report.json", parent.safe(report))
            return report
    return IntegralCase

def unchanged_inputs(inputs):
    errors = []
    for name, entry in inputs.items():
        try:
            raw, record = file_bytes(name)
            require(record == entry["record"] and raw == entry["raw"], "input-byte-mode-final")
        except BaseException as error:
            errors.append({"path": name, "error": repr(error)})
    return errors

def main():
    require(not sys.flags.optimize, "assertions-must-remain-enabled")
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--reference-binding", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--reference-binding-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--native-binding", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--native-binding-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--parent-native-package", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--package-sha256", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    mode = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    mode.add_argument("--prepare-only", action="store_true")
    mode.add_argument("--execute-native", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root, output = Path(__file__).resolve().parent, args.output.resolve()
    parent_root = args.parent_native_package.resolve()
    require(output != root and not output.is_relative_to(root) and
            output != parent_root and not output.is_relative_to(parent_root),
            "independent-create-only-output")
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    inputs, reports = {}, []
    result = {"schema":"heptatorch.sum-integral.native24-comparison.v1",
        "status":"PREPARING", "case_count":24, "reference_case_count":24,
        "reference_sha256":None, "case_contract_sha256":CONTRACT_SHA,
        "source_revision":"sum-integral-source01", "source_sha256":None,
        "native_sha256":None, "functions":None, "units":None,
        "descriptor_bytes":672, "state_format":"HTSINT01", "backing_format":"HTOSIN01",
        "native_executed":False, "Torch_executed":False, "compiler_executed":False,
        "schema_closure":False, "full_project_status":"HOLD", "cases":reports,
        "all_observations_supported":False,
        "all24_execution_index":[{"index":i,"status":"NOT_RUN"} for i in range(24)],
        "bounded_api_controls":{"status":"NOT_RUN","Torch_parity_claim":False}}
    exit_code = 1
    try:
        admit_integral_package(root,args.package_sha256,parent_root,inputs)
        reference, contract, ref_summary = admit_reference(
            args.reference_binding,args.reference_binding_sha256,inputs)
        binding, build, build_summary = admit_build(
            args.native_binding,args.native_binding_sha256,inputs)
        result.update(reference_admission=ref_summary, build_admission=build_summary,
            reference_sha256=ref_summary["reference_sha256"],
            source_sha256=binding["runtime"]["sha256"], native_sha256=binding["binary"]["sha256"],
            functions=build["functions"], blocks=build["blocks"], instructions=build["instructions"],
            units=binding["profile"]["units"], package_sha256=args.package_sha256,
            actual_build_binding_sha256=args.native_binding_sha256,
            actual_reference_binding_sha256=args.reference_binding_sha256)
        if args.prepare_only:
            result["status"] = "PREPARED_NOT_RUN"
            result["case_records"] = [
                {"index":spec["id"],"name":spec["label"],"status":"NOT_RUN",
                 "original_event_count":len(row["events"]),"filtered":False}
                for spec,row in zip(contract["cases"],reference["rows"])]
            exit_code = 0
        else:
            parent = load_module(parent_root/"vendor/replay_direct_view14.py","original_case52c3_integral")
            owner = load_module(root/"owner_integral.py","strict_integral_owner")
            observer = load_module(root/"native_observer_integral.py","integral_native_observer")
            observer.configure(owner,binding["runtime"]["sha256"],binding["binary"]["sha256"],build["functions"])
            Case = case_class(parent,owner)
            run_args = argparse.Namespace(binary=Path(binding["binary"]["path"]),
                source=Path(binding["runtime"]["path"]),protocol=parent_root/"vendor/protocol.py")
            result["native_executed"] = True
            for spec,row in zip(contract["cases"],reference["rows"]):
                directory = output/("case-%02d" % spec["id"])
                try:
                    case = Case(run_args,observer,reference,row,spec,directory)
                    report = case.run()
                except BaseException as failure:
                    report = {"index":spec["id"],"name":spec["label"],"status":"FAIL",
                        "error":{"type":type(failure).__name__,"message":str(failure),"traceback":traceback.format_exc()},
                        "reference_event_count":len(row["events"]),"completed_reference_events":[],
                        "unattempted_reference_events":[{"index":i,"label":event["label"]}
                            for i,event in enumerate(row["events"])],
                        "schema_closure":False,"full_project_status":"HOLD"}
                    directory.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
                    if not (directory/"report.json").exists():
                        write_json(directory/"report.json",report)
                reports.append(report)
                result["all24_execution_index"][spec["id"]] = {"index":spec["id"],"status":report["status"]}
            require(len(reports) == 24 and [r["index"] for r in reports] == list(range(24)),
                    "all-original24-case-records")
            result["passed"] = sum(r["status"] == "PASS" for r in reports)
            result["blocked"] = sum(r["status"] == "BLOCKED" for r in reports)
            result["failed"] = sum(r["status"] == "FAIL" for r in reports)
            result["original_event_count"] = sum(len(row["events"]) for row in reference["rows"])
            result["completed_reference_events"] = sum(len(r["completed_reference_events"]) for r in reports)
            require(result["passed"]+result["blocked"]+result["failed"] == 24 and
                    result["original_event_count"] == reference["operation_totals"]["attempted"],
                    "complete24-and-actual-event-denominators")
            controls = load_module(root/"typed_scope_controls.py","integral_bounded_api_controls")
            result["bounded_api_controls"] = controls.run_controls(
                observer,owner,run_args,output/"bounded-api-controls")
            complete = (result["passed"] == 24 and
                        result["completed_reference_events"] == result["original_event_count"] and
                        result["bounded_api_controls"]["status"] == "PASS_BOUNDED_API_CONTROLS_ONLY")
            result["status"] = "FAIL" if result["failed"] or result["bounded_api_controls"]["status"] != "PASS_BOUNDED_API_CONTROLS_ONLY" else "PASS" if complete else "BLOCKED"
            result["all_observations_supported"] = complete
            result["exact_Python_diagnostic_text_generated_by_native"] = False
            result["exception_scope"] = "Original exact text retained; real native acceptance/cause/payload/full owner rollback compared. No diagnostic text is synthesized."
            exit_code = 0 if complete else 1
    except BaseException as failure:
        result.update(status="FAIL",error={"type":type(failure).__name__,"message":str(failure),
                                          "traceback":traceback.format_exc()})
    finally:
        errors = unchanged_inputs(inputs)
        result["input_recheck_errors"] = errors
        result["all_inputs_unchanged"] = not errors
        result["checked_inputs"] = {name:value["record"] for name,value in inputs.items()}
        if errors:
            result["status"],exit_code = "FAIL",1
        write_json(output/"report.json",result)
    return exit_code

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Pure admission for the immutable actual integral24 and all frozen source inputs.

This module performs byte/schema/source/provenance validation only. It never
imports Torch, launches a process or evaluates Tensor arithmetic.
"""
import hashlib
import itertools
import json
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import re
import stat
import struct

REFERENCE_SHA = "6c9df4b579664c89c200b9d796367dd6d41f93f8260e8ff012f17d5041d2278b"
PROBE_SHA = "2a735361fd263c08f2932a10e253360ba2a86e976653905abad8321c3ef2077c"
CONTRACT_SHA = "9a225a36915650ba805c019b8d97046e7027ca8a8a2b2e246010b9554a3ef4f7"
MANIFEST_SHA = "9ba25bc05fbfef0827641b0efb6075a75ed30495e3f75a09cb72828fc37a2bbe"
SUPPORT_SHA = "ef8fe89aa7dbff4ee03f9d5762d2736a3648d9e48e97ad5df7bec615676f04ae"
LOCK_SHA = "ca2e54ce65083bbe0ab3d47b6878971271765ab35a9dd70725fa345fceed3944"
PIP_SHA = "35ad4841c2f2f94be7ded7f1bcc97f9592f806658ff660bfac5bdc3b0cf986ef"
INVENTORY_SHA = "d204c5a8268a0d0f0a1dd162b5e0ab184beee83310bcad643b084deb691f3f49"
UPSTREAM = "31a77fc9c0a7c6fff15a1ff58c743f53b1a9d457"
CHECK_NAMES = {
    "python_matches", "platform_matches", "version_backend_matches",
    "git_matches_oracle_build_pin", "distribution_version_matches",
    "direct_url_matches", "direct_url_archive_sha256_matches",
    "pip_report_url_matches", "pip_report_archive_sha256_matches",
    "pip_report_version_matches", "pip_report_requested"}
TENSOR_KEYS = {
    "tensor_identity", "storage_identity", "dtype", "device", "element_size",
    "shape", "strides", "numel", "storage_bytes", "storage_offset_elements",
    "storage_offset_bytes", "storage_raw_hex", "storage_sha256",
    "logical_bytes_hex", "logical_sha256", "binary_words", "version",
    "requires_grad", "is_view", "base_tensor_identity"}
SNAPSHOT_KEYS = {
    "tensor_getter_order", "tensors", "relations", "saved_getters_after_tensor_getters",
    "edge_getters", "edges_after_all_tensor_getters", "expired", "state", "tensor_weak_alive"}

def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

def require(condition, assertion_label, **facts):
    if not condition:
        raise AssertionError({"reference_rule": assertion_label, **facts})

def product(shape):
    out = 1
    for item in shape:
        out *= item
    return out

def file_bytes(path, expected=None, inputs=None):
    requested = Path(path)
    require(not requested.is_symlink(), "regular-input-no-symlink", path=str(requested))
    path = requested.resolve()
    before = path.stat()
    require(stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode), "regular-input", path=str(path))
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    after = path.stat()
    require((before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns, before.st_ctime_ns) ==
            (after.st_ino, after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns, after.st_ctime_ns),
            "stable-input-read", path=str(path))
    record = {"path": str(path), "bytes": len(raw), "mode": stat.S_IMODE(after.st_mode),
              "sha256": sha(raw)}
    if expected is not None:
        require(record["sha256"] == expected, "exact-input-sha256", path=str(path))
    if inputs is not None:
        if str(path) in inputs:
            require(inputs[str(path)]["record"] == record and inputs[str(path)]["raw"] == raw,
                    "same-input-reread", path=str(path))
        else:
            inputs[str(path)] = {"record": record, "raw": raw}
    return raw, record

def check_capture(item, path):
    require(isinstance(item, dict) and type(item.get("accepted")) is bool, "capture", path=path)
    accepted = item["accepted"]
    require(item.get("outcome") == ("SUCCEEDED" if accepted else "RAISED"),
            "capture-outcome", path=path)
    if accepted:
        require(item.get("error") is None, "capture-success-error", path=path)
    else:
        error = item.get("error")
        require(isinstance(error, dict) and set(error) == {"type", "message"} and
                all(isinstance(error[x], str) and error[x] for x in error),
                "capture-error-record", path=path)
    warnings = item.get("warnings")
    require(isinstance(warnings, list), "capture-warnings", path=path)
    for warning in warnings:
        require(isinstance(warning, dict) and set(warning) == {"type", "message"} and
                all(isinstance(warning[x], str) for x in warning),
                "capture-warning-record", path=path)

def check_tensor(tensor, path):
    if tensor is None:
        return
    require(isinstance(tensor, dict) and set(tensor) == TENSOR_KEYS, "tensor-fields", path=path)
    width = {"torch.bool": 1, "torch.int64": 8}.get(tensor["dtype"])
    require(width is not None and tensor["device"] == "cpu" and
            tensor["element_size"] == width, "scoped-tensor-dtype-device", path=path)
    for field in ("tensor_identity", "storage_identity"):
        require(isinstance(tensor[field], str) and tensor[field].isdigit() and int(tensor[field]) > 0,
                "tensor-observed-identity", path=path, field=field)
    base = tensor["base_tensor_identity"]
    require(base is None or isinstance(base, str) and base.isdigit() and int(base) > 0,
            "base-observed-identity", path=path)
    shape, strides = tensor["shape"], tensor["strides"]
    require(isinstance(shape, list) and isinstance(strides, list) and len(shape) == len(strides) <= 4,
            "tensor-rank", path=path)
    require(all(type(v) is int and 0 <= v <= 262144 for v in shape) and
            all(type(v) is int and 0 <= v < (1 << 63) for v in strides),
            "tensor-geometry-values", path=path)
    require(tensor["numel"] == product(shape), "tensor-numel", path=path)
    for field in ("storage_bytes", "storage_offset_elements", "storage_offset_bytes", "version"):
        require(type(tensor[field]) is int and tensor[field] >= 0, "tensor-unsigned", field=field, path=path)
    require(tensor["storage_offset_bytes"] == tensor["storage_offset_elements"] * width,
            "tensor-byte-offset", path=path)
    for field in ("requires_grad", "is_view"):
        require(type(tensor[field]) is bool, "tensor-bool", field=field, path=path)
    require(tensor["is_view"] == (base is not None), "observed-base-view-consistency", path=path)
    physical = bytes.fromhex(tensor["storage_raw_hex"])
    logical = bytes.fromhex(tensor["logical_bytes_hex"])
    require(physical.hex() == tensor["storage_raw_hex"] and logical.hex() == tensor["logical_bytes_hex"],
            "canonical-byte-hex", path=path)
    require(len(physical) == tensor["storage_bytes"] and sha(physical) == tensor["storage_sha256"],
            "all-physical-bytes", path=path)
    require(len(logical) == width * tensor["numel"] and sha(logical) == tensor["logical_sha256"],
            "all-logical-bytes", path=path)
    # Integer address decoding of recorded bytes is an observer, not a sum kernel.
    copied = bytearray()
    for linear in range(tensor["numel"]):
        quotient = linear
        offset = tensor["storage_offset_elements"]
        for size, stride in zip(reversed(shape), reversed(strides)):
            offset += (quotient % size) * stride
            quotient //= size
        require(0 <= width*offset <= len(physical)-width, "observed-storage-bound", path=path)
        copied.extend(physical[width*offset:width*offset+width])
    require(bytes(copied) == logical, "logical-from-recorded-physical", path=path)
    words = [int.from_bytes(logical[i:i+width], "little") for i in range(0, len(logical), width)]
    require(words == tensor["binary_words"] and all(type(v) is int and 0 <= v < (1 << (8*width))
            for v in tensor["binary_words"]), "exact-recorded-integral-words", path=path)

def check_primitive(value, path):
    if value is None or type(value) in (bool, int, str):
        return
    if isinstance(value, list):
        for i, item in enumerate(value):
            check_primitive(item, path+"/"+str(i))
        return
    require(isinstance(value, dict), "primitive-schema", path=path)
    if set(value) == {"tensor"}:
        check_tensor(value["tensor"], path+"/tensor")
    elif set(value) == {"double_bits"}:
        require(type(value["double_bits"]) is int and 0 <= value["double_bits"] < (1 << 64),
                "primitive-double-bits", path=path)
    else:
        # Unexpected Python objects remain an explicit unsupported-observation
        # blocker in the native layer, while the original reference is preserved.
        require(set(value) == {"type", "diagnostic_repr"} and
                all(isinstance(v, str) for v in value.values()),
                "diagnostic-primitive-schema", path=path)

def check_node(node, depth, path):
    if node is None:
        return
    keys = {"kind"} | ({"next_edges"} if depth else set())
    if node.get("kind") == "AccumulateGrad":
        keys.add("variable")
    require(isinstance(node, dict) and set(node) == keys and isinstance(node["kind"], str),
            "node-fields", path=path)
    if "variable" in node:
        check_tensor(node["variable"], path+"/variable")
    if depth:
        require(isinstance(node["next_edges"], list), "node-next-edges", path=path)
        for i, edge in enumerate(node["next_edges"]):
            require(set(edge) == {"output_nr", "node"} and type(edge["output_nr"]) is int
                    and edge["output_nr"] >= 0, "edge-schema", path=path)
            check_node(edge["node"], depth-1, path+"/edge/"+str(i))

def check_snapshot(snapshot, states, path):
    require(isinstance(snapshot, dict) and set(snapshot) == SNAPSHOT_KEYS,
            "snapshot-fields", path=path)
    names = snapshot["tensor_getter_order"]
    require(isinstance(names, list) and len(names) == len(set(names)) and
            all(isinstance(name, str) and name for name in names), "snapshot-order", path=path)
    for field in ("tensors", "saved_getters_after_tensor_getters", "edge_getters",
                  "edges_after_all_tensor_getters"):
        require(set(snapshot[field]) == set(names), "snapshot-complete-name-set", field=field, path=path)
    for name in names:
        tensor = snapshot["tensors"][name]
        require(set(tensor) == {"before_grad_fn_getter", "grad_fn_getter",
                               "requires_grad_after_grad_fn_getter", "is_leaf_after_grad_fn_getter",
                               "retains_grad", "gradient"}, "tensor-getter-fields", path=path)
        check_tensor(tensor["before_grad_fn_getter"], path+"/"+name+"/before")
        require(type(tensor["requires_grad_after_grad_fn_getter"]) is bool,
                "requires-after-getter", path=path)
        for field in ("grad_fn_getter", "is_leaf_after_grad_fn_getter", "retains_grad", "gradient"):
            capture = tensor[field]
            check_capture(capture, path+"/"+name+"/"+field)
            suffix = ({"node"} if field == "grad_fn_getter" else
                      {"tensor"} if field == "gradient" else {"value"}) if capture["accepted"] else set()
            require(set(capture) == {"accepted", "outcome", "error", "warnings"} | suffix,
                    "getter-capture-fields", field=field, path=path)
            if capture["accepted"]:
                if field == "grad_fn_getter":
                    check_node(capture["node"], 4, path+"/"+name+"/fn")
                elif field == "gradient":
                    check_tensor(capture["tensor"], path+"/"+name+"/gradient")
                else:
                    require(type(capture["value"]) is bool, "getter-bool", path=path)
        check_capture(snapshot["edge_getters"][name], path+"/"+name+"/edge-getter")
        require(set(snapshot["edge_getters"][name]) == {"accepted", "outcome", "error", "warnings"},
                "edge-getter-fields", path=path)
        saved = snapshot["saved_getters_after_tensor_getters"][name]
        require(isinstance(saved, dict) and list(saved) == sorted(saved),
                "Saved-getter-order", path=path)
        for key, capture in saved.items():
            require(key.startswith("_saved_"), "Saved-getter-name", path=path)
            check_capture(capture, path+"/"+name+"/"+key)
            expected_keys = {"accepted", "outcome", "error", "warnings"} | (
                {"value"} if capture["accepted"] else set())
            require(set(capture) == expected_keys, "Saved-capture-fields", path=path)
            if capture["accepted"]:
                check_primitive(capture["value"], path+"/"+name+"/"+key)
        for i, edge in enumerate(snapshot["edges_after_all_tensor_getters"][name]):
            require(set(edge) == {"output_nr", "node", "matches_live_current_grad_fn"} and
                    type(edge["output_nr"]) is int and edge["output_nr"] >= 0,
                    "snapshot-edge-schema", path=path)
            check_node(edge["node"], 4, path+"/"+name+"/edge"+str(i))
            matches = edge["matches_live_current_grad_fn"]
            require(isinstance(matches, list) and len(matches) == len(set(matches)) and
                    set(matches) <= set(names), "edge-identity-names", path=path)
    pairs = [a+"|"+b for a, b in itertools.combinations(names, 2)]
    require(list(snapshot["relations"]) == pairs, "all-live-pair-relations", path=path)
    for pair, relations in snapshot["relations"].items():
        require(set(relations) == {"same_Python_object", "same_Tensor", "same_Storage",
                                   "same_current_Version_value"} and
                all(type(value) is bool for value in relations.values()),
                "relation-fields", path=path)
        # The wire has Tensor ownership, not arbitrary Python wrapper counts.
        require(relations["same_Python_object"] == relations["same_Tensor"],
                "unsupported-Python-wrapper-multiplicity", path=path, pair=pair)
        a, b = pair.split("|")
        left = snapshot["tensors"][a]["before_grad_fn_getter"]
        right = snapshot["tensors"][b]["before_grad_fn_getter"]
        require(relations["same_Tensor"] == (left["tensor_identity"] == right["tensor_identity"])
                and relations["same_Storage"] == (left["storage_identity"] == right["storage_identity"]),
                "relation-real-identities", path=path)
    require(isinstance(snapshot["expired"], dict) and
            all(isinstance(k, str) and type(v) is bool for k, v in snapshot["expired"].items()),
            "Weak-observation-fields", path=path)
    require(isinstance(snapshot["tensor_weak_alive"], dict) and
            all(isinstance(k, str) and type(v) is bool for k, v in snapshot["tensor_weak_alive"].items()),
            "Tensor-weak-observation-fields", path=path)
    require(snapshot["state"] in states, "snapshot-full-state", path=path)

def admit_provenance(data, lock, pip):
    provenance = data["oracle_provenance"]
    expected = lock["oracle"]
    require(provenance["status"] == "PASS" and provenance["expected"] == expected and
            provenance["metadata_error"] is None and provenance["lock_sha256"] == LOCK_SHA and
            provenance["release_source_equivalence"] == lock["release_source_equivalence"],
            "oracle-lock-complete")
    checks, observed = provenance["checks"], provenance["observed"]
    require(set(checks) == CHECK_NAMES and all(v is True for v in checks.values()), "eleven-checks")
    require(observed["python"]["implementation"] == expected["python"]["implementation"] and
            observed["python"]["version"] == expected["python"]["version"] and
            isinstance(observed["python"]["full_version"], str) and observed["python"]["full_version"],
            "actual-python")
    require(observed["platform"] == expected["platform"] and observed["version"] == expected["version"]
            and observed["git_commit"] == expected["git_commit"] and
            observed["backend_versions"] == expected["backend_versions"] and
            observed["distribution_version"] == expected["version"], "actual-installed-build")
    wheel = expected["wheel"]
    direct = {"url": wheel["url"], "archive_info": {
        "hash": "sha256="+wheel["sha256"], "hashes": {"sha256": wheel["sha256"]}}}
    require(observed["direct_url"] == direct, "complete-PEP610-origin")
    records = [row for row in pip["install"] if row.get("metadata", {}).get("name", "").lower() == "torch"]
    require(len(records) == 1, "single-Torch-install-record")
    installed = records[0]
    require(installed["requested"] is True and installed["metadata"]["version"] == expected["version"]
            and installed["download_info"] == direct, "complete-wheel-install-origin")
    wanted_report = {"path": expected["install_report"], "pip_version": pip.get("pip_version"),
                     "download_info": installed["download_info"],
                     "metadata_name": installed["metadata"]["name"],
                     "metadata_version": installed["metadata"]["version"],
                     "requested": installed["requested"]}
    require(observed["install_report"] == wanted_report, "complete-observed-install-report")
    return {"all_eleven_recomputed": True, "installed_distribution_and_full_origin_compared": True}

def admit_reference(binding_path, binding_sha256, inputs):
    require(re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", binding_sha256) is not None, "actual-reference-binding-pin")
    binding_raw, _ = file_bytes(binding_path, binding_sha256, inputs)
    binding = json.loads(binding_raw)
    required = {"schema", "status", "actual", "reference_source_manifest",
                "parent_reference_manifest", "integral_source_manifest", "external_repo_files"}
    require(set(binding) == required and
            binding["schema"] == "heptatorch.sum-integral.actual-reference-binding.v1" and
            binding["status"] == "ACTUAL_REFERENCE_BOUND",
            "future-reference-placeholder-cannot-execute")
    local = {}
    def read_pin(pin, label):
        require(isinstance(pin, dict) and set(pin) == {"path", "bytes", "sha256", "mode"} and
                isinstance(pin["path"], str) and re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", pin["sha256"]) is not None,
                "complete-real-reference-file-pin", label=label)
        raw, record = file_bytes(pin["path"], pin["sha256"], inputs)
        require(record == pin, "original-reference-full-byte-mode", label=label)
        local[record["path"]] = (raw, record)
        return raw, record

    actual_raw, actual_record = read_pin(binding["actual"], "actual")
    require(actual_record["sha256"] == REFERENCE_SHA and actual_record["bytes"] == 4586123 and
            actual_record["mode"] == 0o600, "immutable-original-actual24-bytes-and-mode")
    packages = {}
    for key, fixed, schema, count, mapping in [
        ("reference_source_manifest", MANIFEST_SHA,
         "heptatorch.sum-integral.reference24-source-manifest.v1", 8, False),
        ("parent_reference_manifest", "7db1e860e6387a0d48b98769eb9f124211a90b92bfb62a07e55eb294ab4ef780",
         "heptatorch.sum-dims-reference32-source-manifest.v1", 38, False),
        ("integral_source_manifest", "cbdb6b7331f1d4f4cf2e1d88cb9306cc17875d9051feca47c958646f04dec6a6",
         "heptatorch.sum-integral.source-handoff.v1", 26, True),
    ]:
        raw, record = read_pin(binding[key], key)
        require(record["sha256"] == fixed, "frozen-reference-package", label=key)
        package = json.loads(raw)
        require(package["schema"] == schema and len(package["files"]) == count,
                "complete-reference-source-package", label=key)
        root = Path(record["path"]).parent
        entries = package["files"].items() if mapping else ((e["path"], e) for e in package["files"])
        members = {}
        for name, pin in entries:
            rel = PurePosixPath(name)
            require(not rel.is_absolute() and ".." not in rel.parts and str(rel) == name,
                    "safe-reference-source-member", member=name)
            value, meta = read_pin({"path": str((root/name).resolve()),
                **{k:pin[k] for k in ("bytes", "sha256", "mode")}}, key+"/"+name)
            require(name not in members, "unique-reference-source-member")
            members[name] = (value, meta)
        packages[key] = members
    own, parent, integral = (packages[k] for k in
        ("reference_source_manifest", "parent_reference_manifest", "integral_source_manifest"))
    require(own["pytorch_sum_integral_probe.py"][1]["sha256"] == PROBE_SHA and
            own["case-contract.json"][1]["sha256"] == CONTRACT_SHA and
            own["case-contract.json"][0] == integral["case-contract.json"][0],
            "unchanged24-case-contract")
    contract = json.loads(own["case-contract.json"][0])
    require(contract["core_case_count"] == 24 and len(contract["cases"]) == 24 and
            [x["id"] for x in contract["cases"]] == list(range(24)) and
            all(x["expected_numeric_output"] is None and x["expected_error_text"] is None
                for x in contract["cases"]), "all24-input-only-cases")
    primary = json.loads(parent["primary-sources.json"][0])
    extra_primary = json.loads(own["integral-primary-sources.json"][0])
    require(primary["commit"] == extra_primary["commit"] == UPSTREAM and
            len(primary["files"]) == 12 and len(extra_primary["files"]) == 6,
            "complete-fixed-primary-source-sets")
    for members, index, prefix in ((parent, primary, "upstream/"), (integral, extra_primary, "")):
        for name, pin in index["files"].items():
            raw, meta = members[prefix+name]
            require(meta["bytes"] == pin["bytes"] and meta["sha256"] == pin["sha256"] and
                    hashlib.sha1(b"blob "+str(len(raw)).encode()+b"\0"+raw).hexdigest() == pin["git_blob_sha1"],
                    "full-primary-SHA-and-Git-blob", path=name)
    external = binding["external_repo_files"]
    require(isinstance(external, list) and len(external) == 2 and
            {p["sha256"] for p in external} == {PIP_SHA, INVENTORY_SHA},
            "exact-two-original-repo-inputs")
    for i, pin in enumerate(external):
        read_pin(pin, "external"+str(i))

    data = json.loads(actual_raw)
    require(data["schema"] == "heptatorch.sum-integral.reference24.v1" and data["status"] == "OBSERVED" and
            data["cases"] == data["planned_cases"] == 24 and len(data["rows"]) == 24,
            "complete24-actual-reference")
    require(data["probe_sha256"] == PROBE_SHA and data["case_contract_sha256"] == CONTRACT_SHA and
            data["source_manifest_sha256"] == MANIFEST_SHA and
            data["bound_parent_reference_manifest_sha256"] == binding["parent_reference_manifest"]["sha256"] and
            data["bound_integral_source_manifest_sha256"] == binding["integral_source_manifest"]["sha256"] and
            data["primary_source_ref"] == UPSTREAM and data["primary_source_pins"] == primary["files"] and
            data["additional_integral_primary_sources"] == extra_primary and
            data["primary_files_read_and_sha256_gitblob_verified"] is True,
            "all-actual-original-source-bindings")
    require(data["case_plan"] == contract["cases"] and data["probe_error_count"] == 0 and
            data["setup_error_count"] == 0 and not data["probe_errors"], "no-setup-or-probe-omission")
    require(data["torch_executed"] is True and data["native_executed"] is False and
            data["compiler_executed"] is False and data["native_qualified"] is False and
            data["closed_schema_count"] == 0 and data["pytorch_api_denominator"] == 2590 and
            data["project_gates_remain_hold"] is True and data["full_pytorch_rewrite_complete"] is False,
            "reference-not-native-or-schema-qualification")
    wanted_env = {"deterministic_algorithms": True, "deterministic_fill": True,
                  "grad_enabled": True, "num_threads": 1, "cpu_capability": "AVX512"}
    require(data["num_threads"] == 1 and data["cpu_capability"] == "AVX512" and
            data["environment_before"] == data["environment_after"] == wanted_env and
            data["environment_restored_within_probe"] is True and data["original_outer_rng_restored"] is True,
            "fixed-build-environment-and-full-RNG-restore")
    require(isinstance(data["build_configuration"], str) and data["build_configuration"],
            "actual-build-configuration")
    provenance = admit_provenance(data, json.loads(parent["inputs/pytorch-oracle-lock.json"][0]),
                                  json.loads(parent["inputs/pytorch-install.json"][0]))
    before, after = data["inputs_before"], data["inputs_after"]
    require(before == after and data["source_files_unchanged"] is True and not data["changed_inputs"],
            "every-original-input-unchanged")
    declared = {x["path"]: x for x in before}
    require(len(declared) == len(before), "unique-actual-input-records")
    expected_records = {name:record for name, (_,record) in local.items() if name != actual_record["path"]}
    require(declared == expected_records, "complete-input-set-and-original-mode-byte-equality")
    states = data["states"]
    require(isinstance(states, dict) and states and data["unique_complete_states"] == len(states),
            "complete-state-inventory")
    for key, state in states.items():
        raw = bytes.fromhex(state["hex"])
        require(set(state) == {"bytes", "hex"} and state["bytes"] == len(raw) == 5056 and sha(raw) == key,
                "complete5056-RNG-bytes")
    operations = {"attempted": 0, "succeeded": 0, "raised": 0}
    backwards = dict(operations)
    targets = {"attempted": 0, "accepted": 0, "raised": 0, "not_attempted": 0}
    snapshot_count = 0
    for index, (row, spec) in enumerate(zip(data["rows"], contract["cases"])):
        require(all(row[key] == value for key,value in spec.items()) and
                row["index"] == index == spec["id"] and row["name"] == spec["label"] and
                row["status"] == "OBSERVED" and row["setup_error"] is False and row["probe_error"] is None,
                "immutable-integral-case-inputs-and-status", index=index)
        require(row["state_before_setup"] in states and row["state_after"] in states,
                "case-full-RNG", index=index)
        target = [x for x in row["events"] if x["label"] == "sum_dim_IntList"]
        require(len(target) == 1 and row["target_attempted"] is True and
                target[0]["accepted"] is row["target_accepted"], "one-real-sum-target", index=index)
        targets["attempted"] += 1
        targets["accepted" if row["target_accepted"] else "raised"] += 1
        labels = ["construct_backing", "construct_strided_input", "sum_dim_IntList"]
        if row["target_accepted"]:
            labels += ["result_requires_grad_true", "construct_explicit_integer_seed",
                       "backward_integer_result", "hold_result"]
        labels += ["drop_input", "drop_backing"]
        if row["target_accepted"]:
            labels += ["drop_result", "drop_seed", "drop_held_result"]
        require([x["label"] for x in row["events"]] == labels,
                "complete-recipe-event-order-no-filter", index=index)
        weak_names, tensor_weak_names = [], []
        publications = {"construct_backing":"backing", "construct_strided_input":"input",
                        "sum_dim_IntList":"result", "construct_explicit_integer_seed":"seed",
                        "hold_result":"held_result"}
        for number, event in enumerate(row["events"]):
            require(list(event["before"]["expired"]) == weak_names and
                    list(event["before"]["tensor_weak_alive"]) == tensor_weak_names,
                    "complete-before-weak-name-inventory", index=index, event=number)
            if event["accepted"] and event["label"] in publications:
                name = publications[event["label"]]
                weak_names.append(name+"_storage")
                tensor_weak_names.append(name+"_tensor")
            require(list(event["after"]["expired"]) == weak_names and
                    list(event["after"]["tensor_weak_alive"]) == tensor_weak_names,
                    "complete-after-weak-name-inventory", index=index, event=number)
            path = "case%02d/event%03d/%s" % (index, number, event["label"])
            check_capture(event, path)
            for side in ("before", "after"):
                check_snapshot(event[side], states, path+"/"+side)
                snapshot_count += 1
            if event["accepted"]:
                require("returned" in event, "successful-return-record", path=path)
                check_primitive(event["returned"], path+"/return")
                if isinstance(event["returned"], dict) and "tensor" in event["returned"]:
                    require(set(event["returned_is_existing"]) == set(event["before"]["tensor_getter_order"]) and
                            all(type(v) is bool for v in event["returned_is_existing"].values()),
                            "returned-object-complete-relations", path=path)
            else:
                require("returned" not in event and "returned_is_existing" not in event,
                        "no-invented-return-after-error", path=path)
            operations["attempted"] += 1
            operations["succeeded" if event["accepted"] else "raised"] += 1
            if event["label"].startswith("backward_"):
                backwards["attempted"] += 1
                backwards["succeeded" if event["accepted"] else "raised"] += 1
        check_snapshot(row["before_final_drops"], states, "case%02d/before-final" % index)
        snapshot_count += 1
        require(list(row["final_expired"]) == list(row["before_final_drops"]["expired"]) == weak_names and
                list(row["final_tensor_weak_alive"]) == list(row["before_final_drops"]["tensor_weak_alive"]) == tensor_weak_names and
                all(type(v) is bool for v in row["final_expired"].values()) and
                all(type(v) is bool for v in row["final_tensor_weak_alive"].values()),
                "actual-final-weak-observations", index=index)
        require(row["events"][-1]["after"]["tensor_getter_order"] == [] and
                row["before_final_drops"]["tensor_getter_order"] == [],
                "all-final-public-roots-dropped", index=index)
    require(operations == data["operation_totals"] and backwards == data["backward_totals"] and
            targets == data["target_totals"] and targets["attempted"] == 24,
            "actual-totals-recomputed-not-guessed")
    return data, contract, {"status": "ADMITTED_ACTUAL_REFERENCE_ONLY", "case_count": 24,
        "snapshots_checked": snapshot_count, "operation_totals": operations, "backward_totals": backwards,
        "target_totals": targets, "all_input_records": len(expected_records),
        "source_payloads": [8,38,26], "primary_sources": [12,6], "provenance": provenance,
        "reference_sha256": sha(actual_raw), "actual_reference_binding_sha256": binding_sha256,
        "native_executed_here": False, "Torch_executed_here": False}
